faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the questions we hear most

items.q: How can I identify my plant from a photo?
items.a: Open the plant identification page and take a clear photo of a leaf or flower, or pick one from your gallery. In a few seconds you'll see the most likely matches with a confidence score, and you can open each one to confirm the right plant.

items.q: How does the plant finder work?
items.a: In the “Find your perfect plant” box you answer a few short questions about where the plant will live, how much light it gets and how much time you have for care, and we suggest plants that fit your home and lifestyle.

items.q: Do you have recommendations for different cities?
items.a: Yes. Use the city-based plant finder to choose your city and see which plants suit that local climate best.

items.q: How do I keep track of watering and care?
items.a: Add your plants to “My plants”, then use the care calendar to see and follow tasks such as watering and feeding.

items.q: What if my plant looks sick?
items.a: Take a photo of the affected part on the identification page to see common problems and how to treat them. The home page also lists the most common plant problems.

items.q: Can I compare plants side by side?
items.a: Yes. Select a few plants and open the comparison page to see their light, water and temperature needs next to each other. You can also save favourites to your wishlist.

about.title: About PlantPal
about.intro: PlantPal is a platform for identifying and caring for plants, for anyone from someone who just bought their first pot to people who have lived with plants for years.
about.storyBody: PlantPal started with a simple question: why is it so hard to find reliable answers about a plant? We wanted a place where one photo tells you what you have, how much water and light it needs, and how to plan its care.
about.missionBody: Our mission is to make plant care simple and enjoyable for everyone, with clear information, practical tools and a community of plant lovers who share what they learn.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: By using PlantPal you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully before creating an account or using our services.

sections.title: Acceptance of terms
sections.body:
Using the PlantPal website and services means you agree to these terms and to our privacy policy.
If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use the services.

sections.title: Our services
sections.body:
PlantPal provides tools for identifying and caring for plants, including photo identification, a plant finder, a plant encyclopedia, plant comparison, a care calendar and a plant lovers community.
We may change, add or discontinue parts of the services at any time.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body:
Some features require an account. The information you give when signing up must be accurate and up to date.
You are responsible for keeping your password safe and for activity under your account. If you think someone accessed your account without permission, contact us right away.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body:
You agree not to use the services for anything unlawful, to harass or threaten others, to post abusive or misleading content, or to try to gain unauthorized access to systems or other people's accounts.
You also must not scrape the site at scale with automated tools or disrupt how it works.

sections.title: User content and the community
sections.body:
You are responsible for the posts, photos and comments you publish, and you must have the right to publish them.
You allow us to use this content to display it on the site and provide the services. We may remove content that breaks these terms without prior notice.

sections.title: Accuracy and plant identification
sections.body:
Plant information and photo identification results are for guidance and education only and may not always be accurate. Photo quality and the plant's condition affect results.
Before any important decision, such as eating or using a plant medicinally or treating a disease, consult an expert. Some plants are toxic to people or pets.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body:
The design, text, logo and components of the site belong to PlantPal or their respective owners and must not be copied or republished without written permission.
Content you publish remains yours.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body:
The services are provided as they are, and we do not guarantee they will work without interruption or errors.
To the extent permitted by law, PlantPal is not liable for damages resulting from the use of information on the site, including harm to plants.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.body:
We may update these terms. The date of the latest change is shown at the top of the page, and continued use means you accept the new version.
For any question or report, send us a message from the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy and security
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains what information we collect, why we use it and how we protect it.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body:
Account information such as your name and email, and, if you provide them, your phone number and profile details.
Information you enter on the site, such as your plants, favourites, posts and messages you send through the contact form.
Photos you upload for plant identification.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body:
We use your information to create and manage your account, provide services such as plant identification and the care calendar, reply to your messages, improve the site and keep it secure.
We do not sell your personal information for advertising.

sections.title: Photos
sections.body:
Photos you send for identification are used only to provide that service.
Please avoid uploading photos that show people's faces or personal information.

sections.title: Storage in your browser
sections.body:
Some settings, such as your theme and display mode, are stored in your browser so the site opens the way you chose next time.
You can remove them by clearing the site's data in your browser settings.

sections.title: Sharing information
sections.body:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share it only with technical service providers we need to run the site (such as hosting), when required by law or by legal authorities, or when you agree.
Content you post in the community is visible to other users.

sections.title: Security
sections.body:
We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, but no system is completely secure and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Do not share your password, and use a strong, unique password for each site. We will never ask for your password by email or message.
If you notice a security problem or suspect unauthorized access, please tell us right away through the contact page.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body:
You can view and edit your profile information from the profile page.
To ask for your account and data to be deleted, or if you have any other question about your information, send us a message from the contact page and we will look into it.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.body:
We may update this policy and will show the date of the latest change at the top of the page.
If you have a question about privacy or security, send us a message from the contact page.
